settings.title: FREE SHIPPING
settings.content:
At Susan’s Aspen Boutique, your satisfaction always comes first.

We believe in keeping you informed every step of the way — from the moment you place your order to the day it arrives.

Enjoy free tracked shipping on every order, delivered safely and reliably with UPS.

settings.title: 30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE
settings.content:
We want you to feel completely confident in your purchase. That’s why we offer a 30-day return policy.

If your order isn’t quite right, you can return or exchange eligible items within 30 days of delivery.

settings.title: 24/7 CUSTOMER SERVICE
settings.content:
Our customer service team is available 24/7 to assist with any questions you may have.

Whether you need help choosing a product, have a question about your order, or simply need a little extra guidance, we’re always here to help.

Please don’t hesitate to contact us — we’ll be happy to assist you.

settings.title: FROM ONE GENERATION TO THE NEXT
settings.text:
For more than 30 years, Susan’s Aspen Boutique has been part of our family.

My mother, Susan, opened the boutique with a simple belief: beautiful clothing should feel personal, be chosen with care, and remain part of your wardrobe for seasons to come.

I grew up around the boutique, watching her select every piece with the same attention she would give to a close friend. Now, I have the privilege of joining her and helping carry that approach into a new chapter.

As we bring Susan’s Aspen Boutique online, we’re staying true to what has always made it special: thoughtful collections, personal service, and pieces chosen to be worn and loved again and again.

In a world where small, independent boutiques are becoming harder to find, every order genuinely means something to us.

🤍 When you shop with Susan’s Aspen Boutique, you’re not simply choosing a piece you love. You’re helping us continue a family story that began more than 30 years ago in Aspen.

With love,
Susan & Olivia

settings.heading: LOVED BY OUR CUSTOMERS
settings.review_1_text: I love the blue-and-white print, and the length is just right for me. The dress feels easy to wear without looking too casual. A simple pair of sandals is all I need with it.
settings.review_2_text: This blouse is exactly my kind of everyday piece. I like the relaxed fit and how it looks with jeans, especially with the sleeves rolled up. Simple, pretty, and easy to make an outfit with.
settings.review_3_text: The soft blue top and floral pants look so nice together. I especially like the loose legs and the little layered detail on the top. It’s the kind of outfit I’d choose for a relaxed lunch with friends.
settings.review_4_text: Really like these with jeans. I wasn’t sure about the color at first, but it goes with more than I expected. Nothing fancy, just a nice everyday shoe.
settings.review_5_text: Just unpacked this and the little floral print is so pretty. Love the green, too. Haven’t tried it on yet, but looking forward to wearing it.
settings.review_6_text: Such a pretty color. I like having a little sleeve, and the neckline isn’t too low. Just added my sandals and I was ready to go.
settings.review_7_text: Really like this color with jeans. The neckline is just right for me, and I’m glad it’s a little longer. A nice simple top without any fuss.
settings.review_8_text: Love this shade of green. Held it up with my favorite jeans and thought, yes, that’ll do nicely. I tend to go for plain sweaters, so this is very me.

settings.title: 24/7 CUSTOMER SERVICE
settings.text: We are always available, providing fast and personalized support, ensuring an exceptional customer experience with professionalism and reliability.

settings.title: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.text: Yes! Enjoy free UPS shipping on every order, with no minimum spend. It’s our little thank-you for shopping with Susan’s Aspen Boutique.

settings.title: How do I find my right size?
settings.text: Our styles are designed to fit true to size. You’ll find a detailed size guide on each product page to help you choose the size that feels right for you.

settings.title: How long does shipping take?
settings.text:
Orders are typically processed within 1–3 business days after being placed. For more details, visit our Shipping Policy.

Have a question about your delivery? Contact us with your order number, and we’ll be happy to help.

settings.title: How can I track my order?
settings.text:
Once your order has shipped, we’ll email you your tracking details. You can also track your order directly on our website for the latest delivery updates.

Need a hand? Contact us with your order number, and we’ll be happy to help.

settings.title: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.text: Changed your mind or noticed a mistake? Contact us as soon as possible with your order number and what you’d like to change. We’ll do our best to help, although we may be unable to make changes or cancel once your order is being prepared or has shipped.

settings.title: What is your return policy?
settings.text:
Not quite satisfied? No worries. You can return your order within 30 days of delivery. We aim to keep the return process simple and straightforward from start to finish.

For full details, please see our Return Policy.

settings.title: I have an issue with my order. How can I contact you?
settings.text: We’re happy to help with sizing, delivery, or any questions about your order. Simply visit our Contact page and send us a message. If you’re contacting us about an existing order, please include your order number so we can help you more quickly.
